premises.text: Construction has been plagued with inefficiencies and productivity has stagnated
premises.evidence_span: Construction as an industry has been plagued with inefficiencies for decades. Productivity has stagnated.

premises.text: A significant amount of materials on job sites are wasted due to errors
premises.evidence_span: almost 20% of materials on a given job site being completely wasted and in the dumpster.

premises.text: Recon Tools aims to create a connected ecosystem of hardware and software to reduce errors
premises.evidence_span: Recon Tools has set out to create a connected ecosystem of hardware and software products to significantly reduce these errors and streamline operations on the job site.

premises.text: The current flow of information on job sites leads to errors
premises.evidence_span: Many simple steps result from anywhere from writing down a measurement incorrectly, reading a tape measure wrong, or simply not following a direction based on the wide variety of resources and labor working on the construction site.

premises.text: A mobile platform can connect data and streamline execution on job sites
premises.evidence_span: as well as a mobile platform to connect all the data together and allow streamlined execution on the job sites.

premises.text: Digital measuring tools should be as common on job sites as traditional tools
premises.evidence_span: to make digital measuring tools as synonymous to a job site as a drill or a hammer.

premises.text: Recon Tools provides a system that has the granularity needed for day-to-day operations on job sites
premises.evidence_span: Recon tools is the only system that has the granularity needed to execute day-to-day operations on the job site.

value.text: Construction operations can be streamlined and errors reduced through digital tools
value.evidence_span: significantly reduce these errors and streamline operations on the job site.

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships were coded.
